name: 60008 · Rolling Mdws, IL
findings: ZIP 60008 (Rolling Mdws) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60008 (Rolling Mdws) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60008 (Rolling Mdws) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
